content: Google Search Event structured data (last updated 2026-09-08): required name, startDate, location (Place with name + PostalAddress); recommended description, endDate, eventStatus (EventCancelled, EventRescheduled with previousStartDate, EventPostponed), image, offers (price 0 for free), organizer, performer. Separate Event per performance/date. Submit sitemap. Don't mark non-events.
